prompt: A train travels 60 kilometers in one hour at a constant speed. How far does it travel in half an hour?
response:
The train travels 60 kilometers in one hour, so in half an hour (which is 30 minutes), it would travel:

\( \frac{1}{2} \times 60 \text{ km/hour} = 30 \text{ km} \)
